annotations.title: Add a site to the Bing Webmaster account

description: Add a site to the connected Bing Webmaster account. Important: ADDING IS NOT VERIFYING, and saying so is most of this tool's value: the site arrives UNVERIFIED and every read on it is refused until an ownership proof is placed on the site itself — an XML file at the root, a meta tag in the home page <head>, or a CNAME DNS record — which no API can do. Place one, then call verify_bing_webmaster_site. Microsoft documents that adding a site which is already there does NOT error, so a success here is not even evidence anything changed, which is why the answer is read back from Bing's site list. It is also NOT shared with this profile until the user ticks it under Settings > Connectors > Bing Webmaster Tools > Manage accounts (or call list_connector_accounts with provider bing_webmaster, then set_connector_accounts). 0 credits.
